archetypes.name: topology-parser
archetypes.rationale: The YAML replacement has narrow grammar and legacy diagnostics to preserve.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the stdlib topology frontmatter parser against the documented accepted and rejected shapes. Focus on CRLF rejection, scalar paths diagnostics, flow-list non-string handling, and --root fixture isolation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: cli-cutover
archetypes.rationale: Many callers moved from standalone utilities to cli.py verbs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace every Makefile, pre-commit, CI, documentation, and harness caller for the migrated commands. Verify no retained harness points at deleted utility files and no stale retired-path references remain outside the migration manifest. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
